item.title: I Found a Dell Tower in the Trash. Five Years Later It's a 6-Node Proxmox HA Cluster.
item.description: The story behind Ced's Home Lab how a discarded Dell tower turned into a 6-node Proxmox HA cluster running Grafana, Prometheus, Kubernetes, TrueNAS, and enterprise-grade homelab infrastructure.
